backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend for a home-services app, with data types and CRUD operations for Bookings and Reviews stored in Maps, including filtering by service/rating and featured review retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs (removing snap scroll, carousel navigation overlays, converting carousels to static layouts, adding fade-up animations) to their affected frontend files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing the purpose and key changes for components, pages, and utilities in the TrustFix app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties (design tokens) for light and dark themes including colors, radius, chart, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the TrustFix React app with cache-control meta tags, Google site verification, and a root div that loads the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for Home, Services (with optional category search param), legacy service detail, Booking, Contact, and Reviews, all wrapped in a QueryClientProvider.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormPopup: Modal popup component with a validated booking form that collects customer details, service, property type, and preferred date/time, then opens a prefilled WhatsApp message on submission.
frontend/src/components/CleaningServiceC: A card component for displaying a cleaning service item with an image, price badge, features list, and booking/WhatsApp CTA buttons, with scroll-triggered fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedReviewsC: Displays a grid of featured customer reviews fetched from the backend actor, falling back to static hardcoded reviews if none are available.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: A fixed floating button on the bottom-left that opens a WhatsApp link when clicked, styled as a green circular phone icon.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button on the bottom-right with a pulse animation and notification dot that opens a WhatsApp chat link when clicked.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer displaying the TrustFix brand, contact info, address, social links, a list of service category links, and quick navigation links.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: A full-width hero banner section with an overlay, headline, description, and two CTA buttons that open WhatsApp for booking or calling.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that composes Navbar, Footer, and FloatingWhatsAppButton around page content, and scrolls to top on route changes.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, desktop nav links, a service search dropdown, a WhatsApp call button, and a mobile hamburger menu.
frontend/src/components/PaintingServiceC: A card component for painting services that animates in on scroll visibility, displays service image, price badge, star rating, features, and provides WhatsApp and Book Now action buttons.
A card component for pest control services showing image, price, features, and description with WhatsApp and Book Now buttons that link to a WhatsApp chat or trigger a booking callback.
frontend/src/components/PricingCard.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/ReviewCard.tsx: Displays a customer review with avatar initials, service label, formatted date, star rating, and review text sourced from a Review backend type.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: A generic service card with scroll-triggered fade-in animation, showing image, price, features, and WhatsApp/Book Now buttons for pest control and other services.
Renders a grid of service category buttons that navigate to the services page filtered by category, plus a WhatsApp chat button.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCategoryG: Displays a grid of service category cards with scroll-triggered animations, image fallback cycling, and click navigation to the filtered services page.
frontend/src/components/StarRating.tsx: A reusable star rating display component that supports optional interactive rating selection and configurable star size and count.
A card component for service subcategories with scroll-triggered animation, showing image, price, features, and Get Quote/Book Now buttons that open WhatsApp or trigger a booking callback.
frontend/src/components/SuccessPopup.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
A form component that lets users submit reviews with name, service type, star rating, and text, using a mutation to call the backend actor and invalidating review queries on success.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for all service categories (pest control, cleaning, painting, etc.), along with contact/WhatsApp utility constants and helper functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
Custom hook that exposes a mutation to submit a booking to the backend actor and then opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeUpOnScroll.ts: Custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when an element scrolls into view, enabling fade-up animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient creation, login, logout, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports three React Query hooks for fetching featured reviews, all reviews, and all bookings from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSearchServices.ts: Custom hook that filters and deduplicates service categories and individual services based on a search query string, returning up to 8 matching results.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, configures Tailwind with CSS custom properties for theming (light/dark), and defines component and utility styles including animations and WhatsApp button effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/Booking.tsx: A booking form page that collects user details (name, phone, service, property type, date, time) and submits the data as a pre-filled WhatsApp message to the TrustFix team.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: A contact page displaying TrustFix's phone, WhatsApp, address, email, and working hours as clickable cards with links.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: The main landing page composing the hero section, trust badges, service carousel, 'Why Choose Us' grid, and featured reviews with scroll-triggered fade animations.
frontend/src/pages/Pricing.tsx: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/pages/Reviews.tsx: A reviews page that fetches all customer reviews from the backend actor and displays them in a grid alongside a write-review form, with loading skeleton states.
frontend/src/pages/Services.tsx: A services listing page that renders categorized service cards (including special painting package cards) with WhatsApp inquiry links and a booking form popup, supporting URL-based category filtering.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom brand colors, fonts (Inter, Poppins), border radii, box shadows, and animations (fadeInUp, cardEnter, pulse-slow, wave) used across the frontend.
project_state.json: Tracks the TrustFix app project state (version 3), documenting architectural goals around removing snap scroll, pagination dots, and carousel overlays, while adding fade-up viewport animations and instant subcategory expansion on the services page.
